2. The prosecution case, in brief, is that on 27.12.95 the condemned prisoner Mainul Haque and the convict appellants Jalil, Abdul, Razzak, son of Amii, Joynal, Mansur, Ramjan, Wadud, Kabil, Bahar, Gaffar, Rashedul Islam, son of Sk. Reazuddin and others were damaging the irri seedlings in R.S. Plot No. 468 purtaining to R.S. Khatian No. 252 grown by Rezaul Karim @ Pachu (since dead). On hearing this information Nur Ahmed Mridha and his sonRezaul Karim @ pachu went to the said plot and forbade them not to damage the said seedlings. P.Ws. 1 to 7 on hearing the said news also followed said Nur Ahmed Mridha and Rezaul Karim. When Nur Ahmed Mridha and his son Rezaul Karim asked the condemned prisoner, convict appellants and others not to mess-up with their seedlings they were chased and encircled in the wheat field of one Samir in plot no. 406, 20/25 yards away from plot no. 468 condemned prisoner Mainul then gave a long Hasua blow on the head of Nur Ahmed Mridha and as a result he fell down on the ground, when the convict appellants and others indiscriminately dealt various blows on various parts of their bodies by Hasua, Kids and Ramdao inflicting serious injuries. At that time accused Khalil (since acquitted) gave a fatal blow on the head of Rezaul Karim @ Pachu by a long Hasua in his hand. Consequently, Rezaul Karim fell down on his face in the said wheat field and there-after convict appellants Joynal, Ramjan, Monsur, Wadud, Kabil, Bablu, Rashedul, son of Khalil and Gaffar inflicted various injuries on different parts of the body of Rezaul Karim by Hasua, Ramdao and Kiris. The informant, P.W.1, as well as p.ws. 2 to 7 saw the occurrence from a little distance. But they could not move forward to offer any help in fear of their lives. On hearing the hue and cry many others came to the P.O. and saw and heard the occurrence. While Nur Ahmed Mridha and his son Rezaul Karim @ Pachu were being carried home they succumbed to their injuries on the way. P.W. 1 Nurun Nabi Mridha, a brother of the deceased Nur Ahmed Mridha, thereafter lodged F.I.R. against 19 accused persons including the condemned prisoner as well as the convict appellants with Singra P.S. Police at 3.05d p.m. on 27.12.95 which was recorded by P.W. 16, Inspector Lutfor Rahman, of Singra Police Station as per the verbal statement of the informant. 

 17. P.W.9, Md. Abdul Khaleque stated in his evidence that he took lease of 1.12. acres of land from the western side of R.S. Plot No. 468 pertaining to R.S. Khatian No. 252 of Shibpur Mouza from the Kalam College authority for 3 years from 1995 to 1998 @ taka 3,600/= per year and took possession thereof. Subsequently he gave this land to deceased Rezaul Karim by a letter of agreement dated 24.6.95 for cultivation with the approval of the Principal of KALAM COLLEGE endorsed on the margin of the said letter. This witness proved this letter of agreement as Ext. 5. This witness also stated that in fact the aforesaid amount of Tk. 3,600/= was paid by deceased Rezaul Karim to Kalam College through him. This witness also proved the lease paper granted by the Kalam College authority in favour of this witness and it was marked as Ext. 6. This witness further stated that deceased Rezaul Karim grew Irri seedlings in the said lease hold land and he heard accused Khalil, Jalil, Joynal, Mainal, Ramjan, Mansur, Wadud, Razzak, son of Jalil, Rashedul, son of Khalil, Abdul, Nizam, Bahar, Manik, Gaffar, Sultan, Razzak, son of Amir Ali, Golap and Bablu damaged those seedlings trampling them under their feet and at that time deceased Nur Ahmed and his son, Rezaul Karim, went to the land of the irri seedlings to protest their wrongful Act. As a result, the said accused persons chased Nur Ahmed Mridha and his son Rezaul. Karim upto the wheat land of Samir and inflicted injuries upon various parts of their bodies and consequently they succumbed to their injuries. This witness denied in cross-examination that the lease hold land taken from Kalam College was previously taken by accused Mainal and others on lease or that they ever possessed the same. This witness further denied in cross-examination that he did not hear from the persons of the P.O. village that there was any gun shot during the occurrence or that any of the accused sustained any gun shot injury in their legs. This witness also stated in cross examination that he could not say whether any of the accused was in the hospital on account of sustaining gun shot injury. 

 19. P.W. 11, Md. Amjad Hossain, principal of Kalam College, deposed that Kalam College had 53 bighas of landed property by way of gift. This witness stated that 1.12 acres of land appertaining to R.S. plot No. 468 and R.s. Khatian No. 252 was given lease to p.w.9, Md. Abdul Khaleque, as the highest bidder on 28.5.1985 @ Tk. 3,600/= per year and p.w. 9 paid the aforesaid lease money on 4.6.95. P.W.9 paid the aforesaid lease money on 4.6.95. P.W.9, Abdul Khaleque came to him on 24.6.95 with the letter of agreement stating therein that he obtained lease from the College on behalf of deceased Rezaul Karim and as such he gave the possession of the said land to Rezaul Karim for cultivation for one year from 1995 to 1996 and this witness as a token of approval of the said agreement signed his name on the said letter of agreement. This witness stated in cross examination that he did not hear any gun shot from the P.O. and he also did not see any person injured by gun shot at the P.O. and also did not know that any such injured persons went to Singra hospital for treatment. 

 33. We now take up for consideration the first contention raised by the learned Advocate for the defence that the prosecution has failed to prove the manner of occurrence, in that the prosecution failed to prove that deceased Rezaul Karim took lease of a portion of plot No. 468, Khatian No. 252 of Shibpur Mouza belonging to Kalam College and grew irri seedlings therein and the condemned prisoner and the convict appellants inflicted grievous injuries on the deceased Nur Ahmed Mridha and Rezaul Karim when they came to the said land and protested against the damage done to the irri seedlings. Consequently they succumbed to their injuries. On the other hand, the defence succeeded in proving its case that plot no. 468 was a part of the waqf property of the mosque and the accused were in possession from before and it was the informant party including the said two deceased persons, Nurd Ahmed Mridha and Rezaul Karim, who were aggressors as they came to the said land armed with firearms with a view to evict the accused there from. The occurrence, therefore, took place when the eviction was resisted by the accused persons and in the process 4/5 persons including the accused sustained gun shot injuries at the hands of deceased Rezaul Karim. At this stage, the people of the adjoining area came and surrounded the deceased Nur Ahmed and Rezaul Karim at the P.O. and they received accidental injuries at the hands of those persons and as a result they subsequently died of those injuries.
